facts.statement: The Station Cash bonus promotion ran from 10am PST on November 23 to 10pm PST on November 30 (2009), with cards redeemed in that window earning the bonus.
facts.quote: redeem it between 10am (PST) on November 23rd and 10pm (PST) on November 30th

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: An SOE news post announcing a Station Cash promotion: a 25% bonus on the Station Cash value of pre-paid Free Realms retail game cards (Starter Cards excluded) redeemed during a set window in late November 2009. It lists retailers that carry the cards. The post's exact date is not shown; it says only 'Posted 6 days, 1 hour ago' relative to the capture date of 2009-11-27.
